model_interpretation.claim: The two valid direct-global candidates produced mixed three-sample results: (32,8) averaged 3.4738 µs versus the 3.5815 µs baseline, while (64,2) averaged 3.5852 µs. This experiment tests a contrasting (32,4) CTA shape—still one adjacent-X row per warp, but splitting each X row across two CTAs—and explicit if/else single-step boundary correction instead of the earlier predicate-style correction. Its larger CTA count could hurt a tiny workload; no speedup is assumed.
